amendment: Replace the label-free initial_concentration_rate diagnostic with normalized KL after one frozen exact-gradient update.
justification: KL from the uniform policy has zero first derivative at the uniform policy, so the originally named first-order KL change is identically zero. The one-update quantity is the first nonzero, operational concentration diagnostic and uses no human outcome.
scope: Label-free secondary mechanism diagnostic only; the primary selector, pressure grid, baselines, endpoint, and success criterion are unchanged.
